class.name: NNBTCooldownTicks
class.brief_description: Sets a branch of the behaviour tree into a cooldown for a number of ticks after its child returns a result other than [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING].
class.description: When ticked while not cooling down, the cooldown node ticks its first enabled child and returns whatever the child returned. Any result other than [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] ([constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS], [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] or [constant NNBTNodes.SKIP]) starts the cooldown, and the node then returns [member cooldown_return_value] without ticking its child for the next [member cooldown_ticks] ticks. A [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] child does not start the cooldown. If no behaviour tree child is enabled, the node starts the cooldown and returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].

members.member: The status returned while cooling down ([constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE], [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING], or [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS]).

Number of subsequent ticks spent cooling down after the child returns any status other than [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] (or when no child is enabled). A value of [code]0[/code] or less disables the cooldown.
How many ticks of the current cooldown have passed. Equals [member cooldown_ticks] when the node is not cooling down and its child can run.
